prompt: Compose an original 90-second instrumental game background cue for cozy crafting and management, exploration state. Instruments: Rhodes, muted bass, brushed drums. 84 BPM, exact steady 4/4. Energy 2/5. Use a repeating eight-bar harmonic cycle. Variation: interlocking low and high motifs over a steady ostinato. Stable consistent texture from the first bar through the last bar, no intro, no build, no breaks, no final cadence or fade. No tempo changes. Keep the lead sparse so repeated playback is comfortable. Original composition for a reusable game loop. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.

description.en: A smooth and relaxing instrumental track featuring electric piano, gentle drums, a walking bass line, and atmospheric synth pads, creating a calm and dreamy soundscape.
description.zh: 一首流畅而放松的纯音乐，以电钢琴为主旋律，搭配轻柔的鼓点、行进的贝斯线和氛围感合成器铺垫，营造出平静而梦幻的音景。
